method: human visual inspection + generated structural metadata, strict whole-scene compliance unverified

cases.limitations_en: The three curve paths and 6 endpoints are mathematically defined; real weave/lighting remains stylized.
cases.notes_ja: 3色の経路を保持した組紐。幾何学的連続性と6端点を優先

cases.limitations_en: Three human silhouettes, six contacts and four table legs; not a documentary photo or fully anatomically realistic.
cases.notes_ja: 3人・6接触・4脚を明示した搬送構図。写真らしさは未達
cases.notes_en: Three adults/six hand contacts/four legs fixed; stylized

cases.limitations_en: Visual causal linkage shown; rigid dynamics and contact timing are not simulated.
cases.notes_ja: 漏斗→坂→鉄球→シーソー→ベルの機構配置

cases.limitations_en: Twelve radial arms equally spaced and exactly one dark lamp; material realism is illustrative.
cases.notes_en: Exactly 12 radial arms with 11 lit and one off

cases.limitations_en: Three refractive balls and stripes; caustics are approximate, not a physically validated illumination simulation.
cases.notes_ja: 3球のガラス屈折をスネルの法則で計算。集光模様は簡略
cases.notes_en: Three glass spheres with analytic refraction; caustics simplified

cases.limitations_en: Five vertices, five bridges, degree two, no crossings; not fully photoreal.
cases.notes_ja: 5島・5橋・次数2の閉路を保証
cases.notes_en: Five islands and five bridges, cycle degree two

cases.limitations_en: Coaxial components in correct listed order, but no verified mechanical compatibility of all watch parts.
cases.notes_ja: 部品順序と軸一致を強制した分解模式図
cases.notes_en: Aligned exploded watch stages; assembly unverified

cases.limitations_en: Four connected stair flights are visible; the paradoxical clockwise uphill reading is subjective/unverified.
cases.notes_ja: 4辺の階段を閉路にした写真風候補。全辺の上り錯視は未検証
